name: overview-band
title: Overview band
description: What Conare is doing for a team, in one band above the numbers: the pipeline's four steps with its numbers, three questions a buyer asks answered in a sentence each, or the dark live panel with the last searches landing.
use_for: The top of Home or an overview, answering "is it working?".
never: More than one band on a page
Red for anything but the step or answer that broke
A live log that keeps scrolling: the last six land once and hold

examples.name: Pipeline
examples.label: Pipeline
examples.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import OverviewBand, { type OverviewStep } from '@/components/product/OverviewBand.vue'
// Pipeline: the website's four steps with the team's numbers, so the console teaches what the product does. A broken
// step turns red where it broke. The numbers count up the first time they show in a session.
const steps: OverviewStep[] = [
  { name: 'Connect', value: 6, unit: ' sources', line: 'Into 4 namespaces', href: '#sources' },
  { name: 'Sync', value: 2749690, line: 'crm stopped syncing', href: '#sources', red: true },
  { name: 'Retrieve', value: 312, unit: ' ms', line: '94.2% strong answers', href: '#performance' },
  { name: 'Deliver', value: 3, unit: ' agents', line: '1,284 searches today', href: '#agents' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <OverviewBand view="pipeline" :steps="steps" />
</template>

examples.name: ThreeQuestions
examples.label: Three questions
examples.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import OverviewBand, { type OverviewQuestion } from '@/components/product/OverviewBand.vue'
// Three questions: what a buyer asks, each answered in a sentence.
const questions: OverviewQuestion[] = [
  { question: 'Is my data in and fresh?', answer: '2,749,690 documents, all synced but crm.', href: '#sources', red: true },
  { question: 'Is it answering well?', answer: '94.2% of searches got a strong answer.', href: '#performance' },
  { question: 'Is it fast and affordable?', answer: '312 ms for a typical search, $268 of credits left.', href: '#usage' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <OverviewBand view="questions" :questions="questions" />
</template>

examples.name: Live
examples.label: Live
examples.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import OverviewBand from '@/components/product/OverviewBand.vue'
// Live: the website's dark panel, the last searches landing one at a time, once, and holding.
const live = {
  value: '2,749,690',
  line: 'documents, searched 1,284 times today in 312 ms.',
  link: 'Open searches',
  href: '#searches',
  searches: [
    { id: 's1', question: 'Which contracts renew this quarter?', agent: 'Support agent', took_ms: 298, outcome: 'strong' },
    { id: 's2', question: 'What did legal say about EU data residency?', agent: 'Claude Code', took_ms: 341, outcome: 'strong' },
    { id: 's3', question: 'Open tickets about the Acme export', agent: 'Support agent', took_ms: 287, outcome: 'weak' },
    { id: 's4', question: 'Notice period in the Acme MSA', agent: 'Codex', took_ms: 1210, outcome: 'strong' },
    { id: 's5', question: 'Who owns the renewal for Acme Logistics?', agent: 'Sales agent', took_ms: 302, outcome: 'strong' },
    { id: 's6', question: 'Refund policy for annual plans', agent: 'Support agent', took_ms: 276, outcome: 'strong' },
  ],
}
</script>

<template>
  <OverviewBand view="live" :live="live" />
</template>
